title: Injecto Polymers IPO Details
intro:
Injecto Polymers IPO is a book build issue of ₹56.12 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 56.12 lakh shares of ₹56.12 crore.

Injecto Polymers IPO opens for subscription on Sep 11, 2026 and closes on Sep 16, 2026. The allotment for the Injecto Polymers IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 17, 2026. Injecto Polymers IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 21, 2026.

Injecto Polymers IPO is set issue price band at ₹90 to ₹100 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,200 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,40,000 (2,400 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (3,600 shares), amounting to ₹3,60,000.

Indcap Advisors Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Integrated Registry Management Services Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Injecto Polymers IPO DRHP for detailed Information.

about.text:
Incorporated in 1998, Injecto Polymers Ltd. business operations include manufacturing packaging products and trading of plastic granules and Polyvinyl Chloride (PVC) resins. Under manufacturing, the company manufactures a wide range of packaging products such as Polypropylene Woven Fabrics & Bags, BoPP Bags, Leno Bags, LD & Polyester Pouches, FIBC Bags, and Non-Woven Bags. These products cater to industries like agriculture, food, pharmaceuticals, textiles, chemicals, construction, and consumer goods.

The company operates on a B2B model , offering customized packaging solutions in various shapes and sizes. Raw materials used include PP, LLDPE, LDPE, HDPE, resins, and specialty polymers.

To ensure quality, it maintain in-house testing facilities and hold ISO 9001:2015 , ISO 22000:2018 , and BIS certification for food-grade packaging.

Manufacturing: The company operates two manufacturing units, 1 in Jaugram, Jamalpur, West Bengal and Unit II is in Howrah, West Bengal

objectives: 1 — Repayment/pre-payment, in full or in part, of certain outstanding borrowings availed by our Company

faqs.question: How to apply in Injecto Polymers IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Injecto Polymers IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Injecto Polymers IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Injecto Polymers IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Injecto Polymers IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of Injecto Polymers IPO?
faqs.answer: Injecto Polymers IPO lot size is 1200 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹2,40,000 , with 2 lots being the minimum application size .

faqs.question: How to apply for Injecto Polymers IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Injecto Polymers IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Injecto Polymers IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Injecto Polymers IPO will be done on Thursday, September 17, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Fri, Sep 18, 2026 . Check the Injecto Polymers IPO allotment status .

faqs.answer: The Injecto Polymers IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Mon, Sep 21, 2026 .
